prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit paint_mask_guide.png as the exact fixed-layout target. design_reference.png is the approved detail/material reference; icon_x8.png is the original colour reference, ignoring its magenta background.
Output ONE transparent PNG on a 3:4 canvas, ideally 1536x2048. Preserve the guide's three columns and FOUR rows of 512x512 cells, all ten silhouettes in EXACT positions, sizes, orientations and outlines. Paint grey pixels only; never enlarge, move, redesign or replace the objects. The guide contains FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty in rows 1-2 and identical views in rows 3-4. Small end-on views and thin edge-on views MUST stay small and thin. Do not replace them with full swords.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour faithful to the approved MM9 Saber painting and original game icon in restrained MM6-MM8 late-1990s realism. Slim strongly curved pale-steel blade, small orange-gold crossbar, distinctive orange-gold D-shaped knuckle bow, short dark-brown leather grip, pale metal pommel cap and pale metal crossbar end caps. Preserve reference details scaled to each view. Unlit colour only, no lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections or outlines.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: repeat the exact five guide silhouettes with FLAT pure colours, NO shading, NO texture, NO outlines, NO antialiased colour blends inside. #FF0000 red for ALL metal including blade, gold crossbar and bow and pale metal caps; #00FF00 green for leather grip and any fur; #0000FF blue only cloth or hair; #FFFF00 yellow only matte wood/bone/horn/stone/paper/wax; #000000 black only gemstone/crystal/glass/pearl/enamel/liquid. Every silhouette pixel exactly one applicable colour, nothing outside. Do not introduce materials absent from reference.
Keep every gap/opening fully transparent, particularly inside D bow. Empty third-column cells of rows 2 and 4 remain transparent. No text, labels, frame, watermark, ground, glow, aura, sparkles or shadows. Preserve exact layout and all silhouettes of target; only surface colour changes.
CORRECTION: The previous attempt had clearly wrong silhouettes with ragged protrusions and stray red/yellow pixels. Repaint the ORIGINAL grey guide precisely. Absolutely clean original silhouette contours, no stray pixels outside; edge-on blades must remain straight narrow lines exactly as guide. No mask colours in upper painted rows. Lower masks clean flat red metal and green leather, no speckles. Both edge-on grip views must be green in the lower material rows. Preserve original guide alpha boundaries and geometry strictly.
